model_load.hint: One-time, 220 MB. You can use the app right away.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.text: Start a meeting and jot down notes. Konspekt will turn them into finished notes.
empty.hint: Or drop existing recordings here — each one becomes its own meeting with a transcript.

meeting.quote_tooltip: Show this spot in the transcript
meeting.delete_confirm_text: The recording, transcript and notes will be gone with it. This can't be undone.

recording.silent: One of the tracks has no sound

notes.placeholder:
Jot down short notes during the meeting.

Konspekt will remember the moment of each line and turn them into full notes afterwards.

summary.empty_text: Click "Generate notes" and Konspekt will pull decisions, tasks and open questions out of the recording.
summary.download_hint: One-time, 1.7 GB. Needed for summaries and questions about the meeting.
summary.backfill_progress: Catching up on missed parts: {done} of {total}

chat.title: Ask about the meeting
chat.hint: Ask anything about this meeting: who promised what, what was agreed, what's still open.

transcript.empty_text: Start recording and recognized speech will show up right away. Lines are split by audio source: microphone is you, system sound is the other person.
transcript.lang_tooltip: Was this line recognized in the wrong language?
transcript.lang_failed: No recording of this line, nothing to redo

dropzone.title: Drop to import
dropzone.hint: Each recording becomes its own meeting

audio.system_hint: System sound is captured from the same device you're playing audio through. If you can't hear the other person, pick the device you're listening on.
audio.save_at_least_one: You need at least one track: microphone or system sound
audio.device_list_failed: Couldn't get the list of audio devices

dictation.enabled_hint: Hold a hotkey, speak, release — the text appears wherever your cursor is: an email, a chat, an editor. Konspekt doesn't need to be open for this.

mode.toggle: Press once to start, press again to stop

dictation.mode_hint: Holding the keys makes it impossible to forget to stop recording. The other mode is more convenient for long text but requires remembering that dictation is running.

paste.type: Type character by character (leaves clipboard untouched)

dictation.paste_hint: Via clipboard the text appears instantly, and the clipboard's previous contents are restored afterward. Typing character by character never touches the clipboard, but takes about a second per line and can drop characters in some apps.
dictation.recording_conflict: Dictation doesn't work while recording a meeting: there's only one model, and it can't do two things at once. Windows won't pass keyboard input from any app into windows running as administrator — in that case the text stays in the clipboard.
dictation.hotkey_taken: The shortcut is taken by another program, so dictation will not respond. Pick another one.

speech.primary_language_hint: The language spoken most often. Speech in it is recognized with the accurate model, the rest falls back to the secondary one.
speech.detect_hint: Without this, foreign speech gets transcribed phonetically in Cyrillic-like gibberish.
speech.langid_missing: The language detection model is needed but hasn't been downloaded yet.
speech.size_queued: This model hasn't been downloaded yet, using the previous one for now.

voices.enroll_hint: Read a couple of sentences aloud and Konspekt will learn to tell you apart from others, even when several people are speaking near the computer.
voices.known_hint: Once you name someone, they're recognized automatically in future meetings.
voices.cancelled: Voice recording cancelled: too little speech

notes_settings.who_writes: Who writes the notes and answers
notes_settings.api_key_placeholder: The key is stored only on this computer
notes_settings.auto_summary: Generate notes right after stopping the recording
notes_settings.hint_local: Notes are generated on this computer. Nothing goes over the network, but the first response waits for the model to load.
notes_settings.hint_remote: The recording is sent to the server you specified. Faster and smarter, but no longer private.
notes_settings.hint_off: Notes and answers are off. The recording, transcript, and your own notes still work.
notes_settings.hint_local_not_ready: The model hasn't been downloaded yet: 1.7 GB will download on the first request.

data.privacy_note: Recordings and transcripts are stored only here and never sent anywhere.
data.cleanup_hint: Removes recordings that no longer belong to any meeting and compacts the database so deleted data actually disappears from the file. Your meetings are untouched.

about.title: A smart notebook for meetings. Recording, transcription and note-taking happen on this computer.
about.check_updates: Check for a new version once a day
about.update_hint: Only the version number and OS type leave your computer. The update downloads in the background, is checked against a checksum, and installs when the window is minimized and nothing is being recorded, so it never interrupts your work. Meetings, recordings and downloaded models stay in place.
about.found_manual: Version {version} is out. Turn on auto-download above or download it manually
about.notice_not_found: The NOTICE file wasn't found next to the app

update.silent_hint: We'll download and install it for you.
update.manual_hint: Auto-updates are off: download the new version yourself.
update.background_hint: Downloads in the background, installs when idle.
update.window_hint: It'll install itself once you minimize the app.
update.recording_blocked: A recording is in progress, the update will install after it

model.status_loaded: Model is in place, will load on first recording
model.download_hint: One-time, 220 MB. You can use the app right away.
model.first_download_toast: Downloading the speech model, 220 MB. You can use the app already, transcription will work once it's done

model.other_instance: Another Konspekt window is already downloading the model. Close the extra window and try again.
model.incomplete: The model didn't download completely, please try again
model.corrupted: The speech model is corrupted and re-downloading won't fix it. Please contact us and attach the log.
model.repairing: The model files turned out to be corrupted, downloading again

summary.disabled: Note generation is turned off in settings
summary.nothing: Nothing to process: no transcript and no notes

chat.disabled: Note generation is turned off in settings

enroll.recording_conflict: Can't record a voice while a meeting is recording
enroll.model_unavailable: The voice recognition model is unavailable: {exc}
enroll.too_little: Too little speech: at least {min} seconds is needed

foreign.ask: There is speech in the system audio. If that is a video or music rather than the person you are talking to, better not record it: otherwise it lands in the transcript and in the summary.
foreign.off_done: System audio is no longer recorded. The meeting keeps recording from the microphone.
foreign.ask_on: There is speech in the system audio, but it is not being recorded. Your caller is probably missing from the transcript right now.
foreign.on_done: System audio is being recorded now. Everything before this stays as it was.
foreign.on_failed: Could not turn on system audio. Check the recording settings.
foreign.doubtful_hint: You said this was not your caller. The line stays in the transcript but will not go into the notes.
foreign.off_done_marked: System audio is no longer recorded. What was captured before is marked and will not go into the notes.

noticed.ask: Someone has been talking on this computer for {seconds} seconds, and recording is off. Record this meeting?
noticed.started: Recording started. Whatever was said before this is gone: we were not saving the audio.
noticed.start_failed: Could not start recording. Check the recording settings.

attention.watch: Notice conversations when recording is off
attention.watch_hint: If someone talks on this computer for half a minute while recording is off, Konspekt will offer to start. Nothing is saved until you agree.
attention.toasts_hint: The question appears on top of other windows, so you can answer without opening Konspekt. Otherwise it waits for you inside the app.
attention.problem: Watching is on, but there is no sound right now: the device is busy with another program.
attention.problem_reason: Watching is on, but there is no sound right now: {reason}.
